programs.title: Richard Hammond's Big!: Mega Ship
programs.desc: Richard Hammond joins the crew of one of the biggest ships on Earth, a monster cargo vessel that uses cutting-edge engineering and the latest tech to deliver vital materials on a nonstop 28,000-mile voyage.

programs.title: Ballroom Blitz: Desert Classic Dancesport
programs.desc: Rose works overtime to dance  Jan is out to prove that injury and divorce won't stop her winning.

programs.title: America's Worst Tattoos: I'll Never Let a Boyfriend Tattoo Me Again
programs.desc: A fellow artist needs help covering one of her tattoos  a client's "party favor" tattoos.

programs.title: Deadliest Catch: Of Ice and Men
programs.desc: Sig makes a desperate bid to save his gear from the descending ice pack while Jake dumps pots to avoid capsizing  when Wild Bill gets a line caught in his propeller far from Dutch Harbor, he enlists Jake's diver to attempt a risky underwater repair.
